gameDescriptionHtml:
Realistic Recreation of War Scenes
The city in the game has been destroyed beyond recognition by war; its former prosperity now lies in ruins. The rubble everywhere, the smoke filling the air, and the gloomy sky all convey the cruelty and ruthlessness of war, delivering an immersive experience to players.

Thrilling Escape Experience
Enemies lurk in every direction. Armed soldiers may appear at any moment, drones patrol the sky without pause, and robotic dogs patrol the necessary paths. Players must also stay alert to collapsing walls, landmines hidden in the soil, and shells that may fall from the sky. Every step is filled with uncertainty and danger.

Amani can control her own small drone, which can effectively distract enemies.

An Emotionally Resonant Storyline
Through delicate plot design and touching emotional depiction, the game shows a child’s pain and struggle amid war. Players are not merely completing tasks—they are experiencing a deeply emotional story.

Innovative VR Scene Recreation and Interaction
Help Amani find that QR code. Players can help Amani use VR glasses to briefly escape reality and return to the warm, peaceful virtual world from before the war. Each time she puts on the VR glasses, Amani shows a long-lost smile. This sharp contrast makes people cherish peace even more.

However, when the glasses are taken off and reality comes into view again, Amani’s heart is filled with endless sorrow.
